source_refs.note: 2. Glycoprotein Hormones: a main subheading of 16.1.1 Chemical Nature of Hormones, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 58-58.

blocks.text: Glycoproteins "conjugated proteins" (jore hue proteins) hain: in mein protein ke saath ek carbohydrate (sugar) group juda hota hai. Yeh bare, pecheeda (complex) aur polar molecules hain, is liye yeh bhi cell membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Glycoprotein hormones
rows: Thyroid gland se thyroxine banwata hai.
Sperm banne ya anday (egg) ki nashonuma ko barhata hai.
Auraton mein ovulation shuru karta hai aur mardon mein testosterone chhurwata hai.
